name: Prominent Chest & Butt Side Profile (S-Line)
summary: Curved side profile with both prominent chest projection and prominent glute projection.
style_goal: Emphasize natural waist definition and smooth transitions between upper and lower curves.

bottoms.reason: Fits curved glute profile without waistband gap.

reasoning.overall: The S-curve profile is naturally balanced; defined waist styling showcases curves elegantly.

styling_tips: Look for jeans with elastane/spandex blend to prevent waist gaping at the back.
Use belts at the narrowest point of your waist.
